core.headline: Two-bedroom maisonette with own entrance, Streatham High Road
core.listing:
A two-bedroom maisonette on the first and second floors above a commercial unit on Streatham High Road, with its own entrance via the rear service yard. A section 42 lease extension notice has been served and can be assigned to the buyer. The bay-fronted living room measures 4.90m x 4.10m into bay (16'1" x 13'5" into bay) and overlooks the High Road.

The ground floor comprises the entrance hall and a kitchen measuring 3.20m x 2.30m (10'6" x 7'7"), fitted in 2022. On the first floor are two bedrooms and a bathroom. Bedroom one measures 3.85m x 3.05m (12'8" x 10'0"), and bedroom two measures 2.70m x 2.40m (8'10" x 7'10").

Access is via a rear service yard shared with the commercial unit below, and there is a shared bin store. There is no parking; pay-and-display is available on adjoining roads.

Streatham station is approximately six minutes' walk away, and Streatham Common is approximately ten minutes' walk. The property is heated by a gas combination boiler, and FTTP broadband is available.

Offers in Excess of £375,000. Leasehold with 89 years remaining; ground rent £350 per year (doubles every 25 years; next increase 2034); service charge £960 per year (y/e December 2025, includes buildings insurance). Council Tax Band C. EPC rating D. Construction is standard brick under a slate roof. There is access via a rear service yard shared with the commercial unit and a shared bin store. The property is above a dry cleaner's on a main road, and there is some traffic noise to the front. The freeholder owns the shop below. Chain involved.
core.summary: Maisonette on Streatham High Road with own entrance and bay-fronted living room. Section 42 lease extension notice served and can be assigned. Kitchen fitted 2022. Streatham station approx. 6 minutes' walk.
